# KFF: first public prior-authorization metrics (2025 data)

- Citation: KFF, "Prior Authorization Metrics Provide New Insights into Insurer Practices, but Gaps Remain", 2026-08-13. https://www.kff.org/patient-consumer-protections/prior-authorization-metrics-provide-new-insights-into-insurer-practices-but-gaps-remain/
- Year: 2026 (calendar 2025 data, posted by insurers by 2026-03-31 under CMS-0057-F)
- Tier: 2
- Sample / method: metrics hand-collected from the websites of 14 insurers (at least 2.5% share) across MA, Medicaid managed care and ACA marketplace; about 71M enrollees.
- Key findings (MA): 12% of standard and 10% of expedited requests denied on average. Standard denial rate from 5% (Elevance) to 17% (UnitedHealth). About 67% of denials overturned on appeal, from 40% (Kaiser) to 93% (Centene); UnitedHealth 60%, Humana 64%.
- Limits: aggregate across all services, so no SNF breakout; percentages only, no counts; formats vary by insurer; posted on insurer websites, not centrally downloadable. Per-insurer values for CVS, Humana and Kaiser are approximate in the fetched summary.
- Relevance: real, public, per-insurer data on payer behaviour, but not SNF-specific.
